```artifact
Feature: Software Clocks and Algorithms

  Scenario: Software Clocks do not overflow within 2 weeks
    Given the software clock is set to 0
    When the software clock is incremented for 14 days
    Then the software clock value is greater than 0

  Scenario: Numeric algorithms do not lose stability over 2 weeks
    Given the software is in a stable state
    When the software is run for 14 days
    Then the software is still in a stable state

  Scenario: Software algorithms run faster than real time
    Given the software is in a stable state
    When the software is run for 1 hour
    Then the software has completed its tasks in less than 1 hour

  Scenario: Software is power-efficient enough to continuously work from battery for 1 hour
    Given the software is powered by a battery
    When the software is run for 1 hour
    Then the battery level is greater than 0

  Scenario: Controller can detect patient inspiration
    Given the patient is breathing
    When the controller is running
    Then the controller detects patient inspiration

  Scenario Outline: Software Clocks do not overflow within 2 weeks (edge cases)
    Given the software clock is set to <clock_value>
    When the software clock is incremented for <days> days
    Then the software clock value is greater than 0

    Examples:
      | clock_value | days |
      | 0           | 14   |
      | 1000000000 | 1    |
      | -1          | 14   |

  Scenario Outline: Numeric algorithms do not lose stability over 2 weeks (edge cases)
    Given the software is in a stable state with <initial_value>
    When the software is run for <days> days
    Then the software is still in a stable state with <final_value>

    Examples:
      | initial_value | days | final_value |
      | 0             | 14   | 0           |
      | 1000000000    | 1    | 1000000000  |
      | -1            | 14   | -1          |

  Scenario Outline: Software algorithms run faster than real time (edge cases)
    Given the software is in a stable state with <initial_value>
    When the software is run for <hours> hours
    Then the software has completed its tasks in less than <expected_time> hours

    Examples:
      | initial_value | hours | expected_time |
      | 0             | 1     | 1             |
      | 1000000000    | 0.5   | 1             |
      | -1            | 1     | 1             |

  Scenario Outline: Software is power-efficient enough to continuously work from battery for 1 hour (edge cases)
    Given the software is powered by a battery with <initial_battery_level>
    When the software is run for <hours> hours
    Then the battery level is greater than 0

    Examples:
      | initial_battery_level | hours |
      | 100                  | 1     |
      | 0                    | 1     |
      | 50                   | 1     |

  Scenario Outline: Controller can detect patient inspiration (edge cases)
    Given the patient is breathing with <breathing_rate>
    When the controller is running
    Then the controller detects patient inspiration

    Examples:
      | breathing_rate |
      | 10             |
      | 20             |
      | 0              |
```
